name: xysz-factor-researcher
description: Quantitative factor researcher for A-shares: runs a complete workflow from data acquisition and factor construction (technical 56 + fundamental 90 indicators) through single-factor analysis (IC/regression/stratification/crowding), multi-factor synthesis (collinearity detection, orthogonalization, 8 weighting schemes, scoring) and screening, to cost-aware strategy backtesting and full performance evaluation with HTML reports. Data sourced exclusively from Xingyao Shuzhi skills.

profession.zh: 量化因子研究员·中国银河证券

displayDescription.en: Chains financial data, fundamental and technical indicator skills into a full factor research workflow: single-factor analysis, multi-factor synthesis and screening, strategy backtesting and performance evaluation.
displayDescription.zh: 联动金融数据、基本面、技术面与因子分析技能，覆盖单因子检验、多因子合成筛选与回测验证全流程。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 开发并验证一个多因子选股策略：用基本面与技术面因子构造候选池，完成单因子检验、IC_IR加权合成与筛选，对沪深300成分股回测，输出含夏普比率与最大回撤的完整业绩报告
defaultInitPrompt.en: Develop and validate a multi-factor stock-selection strategy: build a candidate factor pool from fundamental and technical indicators, run single-factor tests, synthesize with IC_IR weighting and screening, backtest on CSI 300 constituents, and output a full performance report with Sharpe ratio and max drawdown

quickPrompts.en: Develop and validate a multi-factor stock-selection strategy: build a candidate factor pool from fundamental and technical indicators, run single-factor tests, synthesize with IC_IR weighting and screening, backtest on CSI 300 constituents, and output a full performance report with Sharpe ratio and max drawdown
quickPrompts.zh: 开发并验证一个多因子选股策略：用基本面与技术面因子构造候选池，完成单因子检验、IC_IR加权合成与筛选，对沪深300成分股回测，输出含夏普比率与最大回撤的完整业绩报告

quickPrompts.en: Test the momentum factor on CSI 300 constituents: IC analysis, stratified backtest and crowding diagnosis, and output a complete factor effectiveness report
quickPrompts.zh: 检验动量因子在沪深300成分股上的有效性：IC分析、分组回测与拥挤度诊断，输出完整因子有效性报告

quickPrompts.en: Compare a dual moving-average crossover strategy versus a multi-factor selection strategy over the past three years: cost-inclusive net value, win rate, CAGR, max drawdown and full performance report
quickPrompts.zh: 对比双均线交叉策略与多因子选股策略近三年的表现：含成本净值、胜率、CAGR、最大回撤与完整业绩报告
